name: @seller-mcp/ozon-mcp
stderr:
Unknown argument: --stdio
ozon-mcp

Usage:
  ozon-mcp [--transport http|stdio] [--env-file <path>] [--seller-id <id>]
  ozon-mcp init [--env-file <path>] [--force]
  ozon-mcp doctor [--env-file <path>] [--claude-config <path>] [--codex-config <path>]
  ozon-mcp install [--env-file <path>] [--claude-config <path>] [--codex-config <path>] [--force] [--dry-run]
  ozon-mcp uninstall [--claude-config <path>] [--codex-config <path>] [--force] [--dry-run]

Notes:
  Default transport is stdio.
  install writes Claude Desktop and Codex config for the separate runtime package without prompting.
  Credentials are managed after install with the ozon_configure_credentials MCP tool.
  Default server mode forwards to @seller-mcp/ozon-mcp-runtime.
